set.body: M5 of docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md. Build an isolated consumer project against packaged eyes4s artifacts. Implement a custom comparison and a detector or smoother using public interfaces, run published laws, register typed parameters/results and versioned codecs, save and rerun the custom analysis without editing core interpreters. Exercise unknown/duplicate node versions and invalid parameters as named errors. A headless application consumer must list capabilities, explain unmet prerequisites, inspect/diff/load/run plans, consume results, and observe FS2 progress/cancellation. No GUI or plugin marketplace is required.
set.title: Prove downstream method and analysis-consumer extension contracts
